scope: Sequential execution of the rebuilt native SubsetJuliaVM CLI; no stock Julia, WASM, browser, or iPad validation.

cliContract.assertionFailureExit: run_compiled_program uses vm.any_test_failed() to select exit code 1; runtime and pipeline errors also exit 1.
cliContract.trailingValues: Script results are silent, so conditioning-sweep receives an explicit numerical @test and success marker.
